webhooks.sendTestEvent.description: Pretends a webhook service sent an event, like a Ko-fi donation, so you can test your triggers and alerts. Nothing is sent to the service.

parameters.kind: Optional. Which test event, like "donation" for Ko-fi. webhooks.status lists them as testKinds. Leave it out for the first one.

webhooks.sendTestEvent.returns: true when a test event was sent, false when the service or kind is unknown.

webhooks.status.description: Shows each webhook service (Ko-fi, Patreon and so on): whether it is set up, turned on, and how the last delivery went.
webhooks.status.returns: A list. Each service has service, name, configured, enabled, lastDelivery (a time), lastOutcome and testKinds.
